hero.name: Boba Fett
hero.specialAbility:
THE BOUNTY HUNTER
After playing a BOUNTY card, tuck the card under the hero card of any opponent.
When Boba deals damage to an opponent's hero, choose and resolve 1 BOUNTY effect underneath that opponent's hero card.

ruleCards.content:
BOUNTY EFFECTS
BOUNTY effects only resolve when Boba Fett deals damage to an opponent's hero. When this happens, resolve a BOUNTY effect of your choice. Resolving BOUNTY effects due to damage may only happen once per combat.

TRANSFERING BOUNTIES
When a hero with a BOUNTY deals damage to another opponent's hero, they transfer 1 BOUNTY to that opponent. That hero cannot be on the same team as Boba Fett. When an opposing hero is defeated, discard all BOUNTIES underneath their hero card.
ruleCards.title: Bounties

name: Boba Fett
note: Rules-enforced Pro deck (server hero boba-fett), mirrored from the-unmatched.club deck 7289 "Boba Fett" by Inforce (https://www.the-unmatched.club/c/heroes/boba-fett.7289), version 2026.03.03.02.25.10 "Initial". Card titles, types, values, boosts and quantities are the author's, read off the club's /print/__data.json, and are VERIFIED field by field against the engine's data/heroes/boba-fett.rules.ts @c3fa75a (engine #477) by a test. Two spellings differ from the engine on purpose and neither is a rules difference: Durasteel Armor and Bounty: It's Just business are type "defence" here (the community-deck convention the card-type icon is keyed on; the digest normalizes it), and the five cards the engine gives boost null carry boost 0 here, because this client's card type has no null and the renderer draws a pip only on a truthy value. ART IS LAB-ONLY AND TEMPORARY: the card faces are the AUTHOR'S OWN club renders, pulled from this deck's /export/__data.json cardPreviewUrls and mirrored locally so the deck can be played and reviewed on a local engine. The illustrations inside them are scraped third-party comic art across eight hosts (Pinterest, a Bing image-search CDN, a Lucasfilm CDN, Reddit, two comic shops) — none of it the author's to license and none of it ours. These faces MUST be replaced by generated art from the deck-art pipeline before this deck leaves the lab; see issue #671. One card, Slave I: FiresPray Strife, has no usable club render (its preview hash 400s after a late edit), so it and the SEISMIC CHARGE printed on it render through the generated template with the author's illustration in the art panel. The cardback is the author's own (i.imgur.com/IflkGH8.png), mirrored locally; the hero token is a crop of it.
